title: Local test for affine frequency characters
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, and let $a\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The three-query affine character tester accepts every sign-valued function that is a character with frequency in the affine subspace $a+V^\perp$, with acceptance probability $1$. Moreover, for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$, if a sign-valued function has relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from every such character, then its rejection probability is strictly greater than $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: The tested function is farther than $\varepsilon$ in relative Hamming distance from every property function
